tests.name: Partial Correlation Test
tests.interpretation: Correlation fully explained by host mass; no residual TEP signal

tests.name: Collinearity Assessment
tests.note: σ and mass are separable; good discrimination potential

tests.name: Functional Form Test
tests.note: Correlation present in unscreened, absent in screened - TEP signature

tests.name: Observable Comparison Test
tests.note: Both observables correlate - suggests common driver (mass/metallicity)

overall.assessment: SN Ia mB-σ correlation is primarily the standard mass step effect
overall.tep_contribution: None detected above mass step baseline

recommendations: SN Ia channel cannot distinguish TEP from mass step. Consider this exploratory only; do not present as primary evidence.
Future work: Use independent mass estimates (e.g., SED fitting) to break σ-M degeneracy.
